newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Oppn urges govt to keep steel plant open.
newsitem.headline: Australia Oppn urges govt to keep steel plant open.

text.p: Australian Opposition Leader Kim Beazley said on Tuesday Prime Minister John Howard should intervene to reverse The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd's decision to close its Newcastle steel-making plant.
"He must speak to the BHP board and get them to change their mind," Beazley told reporters.
"The government is now going to have to act," he said.
"They (the government) have added to the recession and the economic difficulties of regional Australia with the sorts of decisions they've taken."
